vb_textbox.text: It is not always obvious which one is best, start with either one. You will eventually see which one has the higher amount, keep with that one for a few turns, once it starts dropping to 3 change to the other gnome. If that score is better, continue with that one for a few turns. Sometimes, both might give 0, 1 or 2. You just need to find the pattern again for the higher ones.
